To initiate a trade in the Golden Blitz event, simply tap on the Golden Blitz icon and you will be presented with two cards on the screen. From these options, select the sticker you wish to trade. It's important to note that you can only send a gold sticker if you have a duplicate of it in your collection. Once you have made your selection, choose the friend you want to send the sticker to and complete the trade. Remember that there is a maximum limit of five trades per day that you can make [...] # Monopoly Go! Golden Blitz

Golden sticker banner.

Golden sticker banner.

Golden Blitz was introduced to Monopoly Go! as a dedicated event for players to trade their gold stickers. During this event, players have the opportunity to trade maximum five of the gold stickers per day that are featured in the event. It is important to note that gold sticker trading is only available while the Golden Blitz event is running.
